t: The Sylvania RefLED Superia GU10 LED Light Bulb provides premium performance and an ultra-efficient lighting solution, maintaining the familiar look and size of traditional GU10 lamps. This dimmable 3.7W LED delivers 345 lumens with a 36° beam angle, making it ideal for accent lighting in kitchens, retail displays, and general commercial installations. Provides an impressive 25,000-hour average rated life with Coolfit functionality to ensure protection against overheating offering reliable performance.
